root_cause: Revision2 correctly materialized libdiscover .mo catalogs under debian/test-root/usr/share/locale, but it exported XDG_DATA_DIRS only around dh_auto_test. Under the active debhelper compatibility behavior, XDG_* is reset before the underlying build-system test invocation; the authoritative ctest log therefore showed no XDG_DATA_DIRS in the CategoriesTest environment and KLocalizedString still found only en_US.
repair_scope: Packaging/test invocation only. Revision3 must keep the staged unchanged CMake install tree but invoke the filtered upstream CategoriesTest directly with ctest while XDG_DATA_DIRS and QT_QPA_PLATFORM are present. Do not patch KDE source/assertions or change Qt/Frameworks.
reentry: Increment Debian revision to 6.7.5-0supralinux3, mark preflight49 inapplicable only for revision3 packaging bytes, add a cheap regression that rejects dh_auto_test for this override and requires direct filtered ctest under the staged XDG_DATA_DIRS, then obtain a fresh authoritative input preflight before Attempt3.
